title: Telling the time
examples: Teacher, how do I know when it is half past?
What does the big hand show on the clock?
Can you show me quarter to using the clock?

explain.say: Look at the big hand on the clock. This hand tells us the minutes. It moves all the way around the clock face.
When the big hand points to the twelve, it means it is exactly o'clock. The small hand shows the hour number.
If the big hand points to the six, it means we are at half past. This is thirty minutes past the hour.

items: Big hand at six = half past

explain.say: When the big hand points to the nine, it means we are at a quarter past. This is fifteen minutes past the hour.

items: Big hand at nine = quarter past

explain.say: If the big hand points to the three, it means we are at a quarter to. This is fifteen minutes before the next hour.

items: Big hand at three → Quarter to

faq.q: What does the small hand show on the clock?
faq.a: The small hand shows us the hour. It tells us which number the time is near. You can also ask what hour the small hand points to.
asks: What is the small hand for?

faq.q: How many minutes are in half past?
faq.a: Half past means thirty minutes have passed since the hour started. The big hand points straight down to the six.
asks: What is 30 minutes on a clock?
Where does the big hand go for half past?

faq.a: Quarter to means there are only fifteen minutes left until the next hour. The big hand points to the nine.
asks: If it is quarter to, how many minutes are left?
What time is it when the big hand is at the nine?

faq.q: Is 'quarter past' the same as 'quarter to'?
faq.a: No, they are different. Quarter past means fifteen minutes after the hour. Quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour.
asks: What is the difference between quarter past and quarter to?

faq.q: If the big hand is on the twelve, what time is it?
faq.a: If the big hand is on the twelve, it means the time is exactly o'clock. The small hand will point to the correct hour.
asks: What does the twelve on the clock mean?
What time is it when the big hand is at twelve?

facts: A full circle on a clock face is sixty minutes.
The big hand moves in increments of five minutes.
O'clock means the minutes are zero.
Half past means thirty minutes have passed.

quiz.say: If the small hand is on three and the big hand is on the twelve, what time is it?
quiz.why: When the big hand is on the twelve, the time is exactly o'clock.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the small hand is pointing to three, not two.
wrong.2: This is wrong because fifteen minutes is when the big hand is on the three.
wrong.3: This is wrong because thirty minutes is when the big hand is on the six.

quiz.say: The big hand points to the six. What time is it?
quiz.why: The big hand pointing to the six means thirty minutes have passed, which is half past.

wrong.0: This is wrong because thirty minutes is more than fifteen minutes.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the small hand must also point to the correct hour.
wrong.3: This is wrong because quarter to means the big hand is pointing to the nine.

quiz.say: The big hand points to the nine, and the small hand is on one. What time is it?
quiz.why: The big hand on the nine means fifteen minutes before the next hour, which is quarter to.

wrong.1: This is wrong because quarter past means the big hand is pointing to the three.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the big hand shows the minutes, not just the hour.
wrong.3: This is wrong because quarter to is always fifteen minutes before the next hour.
